# Trump approval rating slips among Alabama voters, new poll finds

Jennifer Lindahl Bonnie Bolden Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Montgomery Advertiser

Updated Sept. 3, 2026, 1:50 p.m. CT

President Donald Trump’s approval rating among Alabama voters has slipped in recent weeks, according to the latest Civiqs polling, even as he continues to hold a positive overall rating in the state. [...] AP News' poll from the Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research says Trump's approval rating stands at 66% against and 33% for him as of July 23.
 Fox News' poll says Trump stands at 61% against and 39% for as of July 17-20.
 Reuters/Ipsos' poll says Trump stands at 63% disapproval, 33% approva
results.title: Trump approval rating slips among Alabama voters, new poll finds

results.content:
Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] According to the Civiqs poll, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 disapprove—giving him a net approval rating of +22 when rounding up.

Despite repeated offers of financial gain, Americans gave Trump poor ratings across several recent polls, reaching as high as a 61% disapproval rating in a Sept. 4-8 Economist/YouGov poll. In Michigan, a Sept. 9 Civiqs poll reported a 58% disapproval rating for Trump.

Real Clear Politics, which aggregates data from numerous polls, shows Trump's current average approval rating is 17.5 percentage points below his average disapproval rating — a similar trend from early September. [...] Rasmussen Reports:

The Rasmussen Reports survey did not break down party affiliation of respondents or Trump's approval ratings on policy issues.
